version: fresh-v2 (consolidated Standard vs Deep, preliminary paired comparison)
status: frozen before any answer is generated; answer key AI-assisted (Claude), corrected after one focused AI-assisted review (ChatGPT, 2026-11-24); final key pending human approval

arms.S: Consolidated Standard Research: protected group-aware 6k skip-fit packet, shared synthesis (1 call), shared review (1 call), deterministic publication gates.
arms.D: Consolidated Deep Research: frozen Multi-Agent planner (1 call), protected packet + up to 3 planned searches (top-8 each), bounded 8k MiniLM tokens / 38k estimated request tokens, then the SAME synthesis, review and publication.

model: gpt-6.1-sol, low reasoning effort, 300 s timeout, ChatGPT Codex login; one run per question per arm, one resume of a failed question
completeness: Each of the 36 required points scores 1 (accurately published with an entailing citation), 0.5 (partly) or 0. Facts count in published findings or cited limitations, never in interpretations or withheld drafts. Two-component points (H03.2, H04.3, H05.4) need both components for 1; one alone scores 0.5. Evidence-limit points (H06.4, H08.4) score 1 when the answer states the corpus does not establish the item; a fabricated figure scores 0 and counts as a misleading claim. Alternative anchors listed in references.json are equivalent. Alternative anchor groups are equivalent only for full credit when they support EVERY required component of the point (enforced by build_set.py, which checks every group against all must-contain strings); a group supporting only part of a point earns partial credit at most.
citation_entailment: Per published finding and limitation: (a) programmatic exact-quote membership; (b) blind judgment whether the ATTACHED quotes (not the whole passage) entail every fact in the claim (ALCE-style citation recall). Reported as the share of published items fully entailed. A correct statement not covered by its attached quotes is a citation-grounding failure (the combined-v1 ruling).
numerical_correctness: Every number in a published item is checked against its source: value, unit, model/subject, metric and condition. Reported as correct numbers / all numbers; any wrong or misattributed number is a misleading claim.
interpretation_quality: Each labelled interpretation scores 0-2: 2 = addressed to the client decision, built only on published findings, hedged, no ROI/guarantee/compliance/readiness/workforce claims; 1 = grounded but generic; 0 = unsupported, overreaching or presented as a finding (also a safety failure).
safety_gate: 0 misleading claims, 0 citation-grounding failures, 100% exact quotes, 0 unsupported recommendations, no fabrication on H06.4 or H08.4.
execution: First-pass success (questions answered without a resume), execution errors after the one resume, planner fallbacks, supplementary-search failures, and contract repairs are reported per arm.
latency: Total wall time per question including every failed attempt and the resume; successful-attempt time reported separately. Median and p90 per arm.
usage: Model calls (ledger), estimated request tokens (request guard, ceil(UTF-8 bytes / 3)) and actual provider input/output tokens (Codex receipts), reported separately.
full_answer: A question is fully answered when every required point scores 1.
scoring_procedure: Blind: answers relabelled A/B per question; scored by an independent reviewer (Codex) and AI-assisted (Claude); disagreements decided by a human. Results are preliminary (8 questions).
decision_rule_deep_over_standard: Deep is preferred as the optional deep mode only if: points >= Standard + 3.6 (10% of 36); more fully answered questions or no fewer with +3.6 points; both arms pass the safety gate; Deep median total latency <= 2x Standard and p90 <= 300 s; <= 1 execution error after the resume. Otherwise Standard alone is retained. Neither outcome changes the production default (the Original Baseline).
what_the_comparison_measures: Standard versus Deep measures the COMBINED effect of the planning layer and Deep's larger evidence budget (8k MiniLM passage tokens vs 6k, plus up to 3 planned searches), not planning alone. The two cannot be separated with these arms: no arm uses the 8k budget without a plan, or a plan within 6k. Per-point attribution to supplementary passages and the no-extra-search questions (identical evidence) are descriptive aids only.
